text:
Kris (acme-prod): Hey team — I just tried to redeem the promo code SPRINGLAUNCH2026 and the dashboard shows the credit applied to our test tenant (t-acme-test) hosted SKU, not to our dedicated prod tenant (t-acme-prod). We need this on dedicated-standard for our prod rollout tomorrow. Can someone check?
Nina (support): Sorry about that, Kris — can you paste the promo code exactly and the tenant id you expected it on? Also any grant id from the confirmation email would help.
Kris (acme-prod): Code above is exact: SPRINGLAUNCH2026. Expected tenant: t-acme-prod. Confirmation email shows grant id g-98765 and transaction tx-20260305-11.
Nina (support): Thanks. I'm pulling the grant now. @billing-bot can you surface the audit entry for g-98765? :eyes:
billing-bot: audit: grant g-98765 assigned -> tenant t-acme-test, sku hosted-sandbox, region eu-west-1, applied_at 2026-03-05T15:22:13Z (by self-serve).
Raj (billing): Looks like the user redeemed from the web console while scoped to their sandbox org. The grant is still fully unused (balance: 1000 USD). We can reassign if it's not locked to the hosted SKU.
Marta (eng-ops): Quick check — some grants are SKU-bound. I queried the grants DB: g-98765 has product_lock = "any" and region = "eu-west-1". So reassign allowed, but must maintain region. If we move to t-acme-prod we should update the allocation record and emit a new audit event.
Nina (support): @Kris can you confirm t-acme-prod runs in eu-west-1? If yes we'll start the handoff.
Kris (acme-prod): Confirmed, prod is in eu-west-1. No part of the grant has been consumed.
Marta (eng-ops): Ok planning to run an admin transfer now. I'll use the internal tool. Command (admin only):
```
rb-admin credits transfer --grant g-98765 --from-tenant t-acme-test --to-tenant t-acme-prod --to-sku dedicated-standard --region eu-west-1 --reason "redeemed on wrong org via console"
```
Marta (eng-ops): Will run in 2 minutes after notifying Raj for billing reconciliation. @Raj please ack.
Raj (billing): Ack. I'll record the change against account ACME-001 and update invoice mapping.
Marta (eng-ops): Done. Ran transfer: return code 0. New allocation: g-98765 -> tenant t-acme-prod, sku dedicated-standard, region eu-west-1. Audit id a-44321.
Nina (support): Kris — I moved the promo credit to your prod tenant and SKU. You should see the credit in the billing UI and it should be available for dedicated provisioning. Can you confirm you can now redeem against the dedicated order flow?
Kris (acme-prod): I see the credit on t-acme-prod and it's available when I attempt provisioning. Thank you! :tada: Any follow-ups to prevent accidental redeems?
Nina (support): We'll add a tooltip warning when redeeming from sandbox orgs and a follow-up confirmation modal for org-scoped redemptions. I've filed INF-2145 to track.
Raj (billing): I'll also add a reconciliation script to flag grants applied to orgs with mismatched default_sku within 24h.
Marta (eng-ops): Note for on-call: if a grant had been partially consumed we would need to do a prorated split instead of a direct transfer. Leaving a note in the audit: "transfer performed, no consumption".
Kris (acme-prod): Great — appreciate the quick turnaround.
Nina (support): Closing here — reopen if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
